peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 7.5% below its local comparables; 15 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (91.2): 4.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 83 of 91 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Khatib MRT about 480 m, Yishun MRT about 1,770 m; closer than 45 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Naval Base Primary School about 560 m; more than 44 of 94 similar developments (the same as 17). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 35 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Yishun Park Hawker Centre about 1,710 m; nearest park Lower Seletar Reservoir Park about 170 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 12 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 188 resales (188 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Chencharu Close (government land sale site, awarded, about 875 homes), about 740 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 188 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 14 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 188 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 240 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−21.7%). Planning-area private resales −19%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
